purpose: Diagnose failures from reproduction through confirmed root cause.

trigger: Investigate why this test intermittently fails
Debug this crash and repair the underlying cause
Identify the root cause of a broken integration
do_not_trigger: Implement a new feature that has no observed failure

preflight: Preserve the exact failing input and environment.
Separate observed facts from hypotheses and avoid changing code prematurely.
Identify the initial failing revision and a smallest reproducer.
workflow: Reproduce the failure and record the trace.
Test alternative causes and isolate the responsible component.
Apply a bounded fix with a regression test.
Verify the original failure is gone without hiding new regressions.

evidence.how_to_verify: Capture deterministic failing command, input and observed output.
Record causal evidence and why plausible alternatives were excluded.
Run targeted and related tests at the fixed revision.

failure_modes: If reproduction is impossible, label the theory unverified and avoid broad patches.
If the fix changes unrelated behavior, stop and request scoped review.
